regime_context: The TSX detector is led by Oil & Gas Producers on strong breadth (0.929) but with a crowded flag, and the trend-gate backtest is validated for drawdown control (gate_helps true). Rotation breadth is broad (8/16 eligible) with no single dominate narrative, so this is a multi-theme trend-following regime rather than a momentum-alpha signal. Honesty note: track_record dir_accuracy is 0.319, so most directional calls have failed historically; lean low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Pipelines & Midstream (rank 3, breadth 1.0, durability_bar 0.77, trend hurst) confirms a handoff from Oil & Gas Producers as the energy leadership broadens — the condition to retire this watch is XEG.TO making a new 20-day high while pipelines breadth stays at 1.0 and the rotation margin between oil/gas and banks stays above 1.0 for five consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is eligible, top-ranked, with extreme breadth (0.929) and the highest durability_bar (0.69) among leaders, suggesting staying power despite mixed hurst. The crowded flag (z=1.18) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Lean is based on the absolute-trend gate and breadth cohesion, not on rank as alpha.
evidence: eligible true with breadth 0.929 (highest among all themes)
gate_helps true — trend discipline valid for drawdown control on this market

theses.dissent: Crowded conditions plus mixed hurst tag and a rank score that historically has rank-IC ~0 — the concentration may already discount further upside, and energy can reverse sharply on a macro headline.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO trades below its 50-day average and lags the S&P/TSX by 5% or more before 2026-11-19

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is a clear second theme with a real trend hurst tag, high breadth (0.857), durability_bar 0.71, and not crowded (z=0.44). It is the strongest non-energy eligible financials theme and sits within the broad rotation structure. Lean is supported by the trend-gate discipline.
evidence: crowding_z 0.44 — not crowded, no sizing caution
theses.dissent: Financials are rate-sensitive and this trend could be disrupted by a single BoC or macro surprise; the sector's rank is distant from the leader (score 0.847 vs 2.24), suggesting modest relative strength only.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its 50-day average and underperforms the S&P/TSX by 4% before 2026-11-24
